blocks.text: Where the files were silent on a detail the sound needed, we made educated guesses — and argued about them. The footsteps are the clearest case.

"The only thing is that Tilly's footsteps don't sound like the footsteps of a young girl in the 1930s. [...] This is a place that's meant to train young girls to become proper ladies, so it feels strange to hear relatively soft footsteps with a sole that sounds modern. It should be wood on a wooden floor." — Tzlil

"We did not know what kind of shoes the girls wore, an issue that might sound insignificant, but is central in the context of the podcast where footsteps carry so much of the narrative. [...] We also found a photograph of girls from Huize Dina wearing wooden-soled, high-heeled shoes. This photograph gave us a good clue as to what their footsteps might have sounded like." — Amit
The way each girl reacts to what she hears was decided the same way: from the files, including the detailed psychological reports they contain.
